questions: Check selective/explicit activation, companion packages, local-edit protection and uninstall safety.
Evaluate schema drift, versions, docs budgets, dependency/secret handling and actual platform test coverage.
decision: Validate the actual distributable and installed dependency layout, preserve edited user installations, and separate metadata-only pack inspection from lifecycle/full-suite execution.
code_observations: The installer distinguishes managed source and installed variants, supports selective/explicit activation and protects locally edited copies.
package.json includes docs in the distributable file set. Adding plan/research artifacts requires an explicit packaging exclusion and actual tarball-list test.
Two related skills are packaged with shared-resolution behavior. A companion archive alone is not proof of a working installed pair.

implementation_steps: Define the minimal intended npm/skill file manifest and exclude planning controls, research execution logs, credentials, caches and transfer artifacts.
Test npm pack --dry-run --json against that manifest, and test actual staged skill ZIP membership and size. A .gitignore alone is not the packaging contract.
Preserve source/installed hashes for activation transforms and refuse overwrite/uninstall of local edits unless explicitly authorized.
Add compatible version checks for companion resolution, including missing and mismatched installations, while preserving supported old layouts.
Keep CI permissions minimal and include supported Node/Python plus Windows/POSIX behavior. Report skips and unsupported platform cases rather than a single unqualified pass.
Check actual pack manifests for required runtime files and forbidden plans, receipts, credentials and logs.
Separate ignore-scripts metadata inspection from full lifecycle validation and test the extracted distributable layout.
Preserve local installation edits and rollback failed upgrades without changing global configuration.
proposed_acceptance_tests: No native plan, private log, .env, bytecode or node_modules entry appears in a distributable archive.
Selective-explicit-selective round trips retain correct hashes and policy metadata.
A locally edited installed file prevents automatic replacement/removal.
Companion packages resolve a matching shared runtime after a clean temporary install.
CLI/docs/version constraints and actual package contents are checked without publishing.
A nested planning file is rejected even when docs is included in package files.
Both skills resolve shared runtime resources after clean temporary installation.
An edited installed SKILL.md prevents overwrite without explicit force authorization.
Metadata-only pack evidence cannot be reported as a full prepack or test pass.

previous_decision: Harden distribution around actual package manifests, managed-copy integrity and supported platform contracts, without modifying user installations during development.
revision_delta: The revision adds lifecycle-script distinctions, installer rollback/dependency checks, artifact secret scans and workflow least privilege rather than treating a dry-run file list as a complete release test.
decision_analysis: The npm files allowlist includes docs, so merely adding an ignore rule may still leave planning or diagnostic material in a release. Inspect the actual JSON pack manifest and assert positive required paths and negative forbidden classes. A metadata-only ignore-scripts inspection does not prove prepack scripts, tests or a normal install passed.

Test the built tarball/skill archive in a temporary installation layout, including the validate-or-fix dependency on shared runtime files. Validate internal resource references and executable modes on each supported platform. Do not derive package completeness from the source tree alone or from a ZIP that omits required empty directories.

Managed installation hashes protect local edits. Upgrade must compare expected old/source/installed variants, stage changes, validate and commit atomically where possible, with rollback on failure. Never overwrite user-specific SKILL.md or global routing config to make an installer test succeed.

CI should run untrusted changes with read-only permissions and keep publishing credentials isolated from test execution. Pin dependency/action identities according to supported repository policy. Archive only necessary logs with redaction and retention; do not export the entire home directory, provider session cache or plan workspace.

applicability_rule: Refresh only evidence contradicted by the installed CLI, selected account/billing plan or changed code contract. Unknown required capability blocks that candidate; it does not justify widening permissions.
